svg.title: Power spectrum of the radial velocities of GJ 570 A, five nights
svg.desc: The power spectrum of 2,250 velocities from five nights. Peaks crowd together near 4.7 mHz, where the smoothed power rises above the white-noise level: the star's oscillations, with periods of three to four minutes.
svg.text: Power spectrum of the five nights
2,250 velocities, weighted sine fits; from the data

g.text: ≈ 790 μHz wide, ×3 as in the paper's Fig. 3
